platform: theory-clean: 2L attention-only, NO LayerNorm (user directive 2026-07-17, drop not linearize), gated_occ + null_occ, seed 0, 9000 steps

loss_gate.note: full-QK reaches ~Bayes and captures ~75% of the gate; loss gate does NOT vanish on null (0.0544) because LN-free pos-only cannot filter the occluded child chain (rung-2 affine-null penalty realized) -> loss gate is not the gate isolator; the cut is.

verdict.headline: The parent->child hierarchy gate is carried by OV (values), NOT the QK coupling. The targeted FRA-QK cut is a gauge-robust NULL; the FRA-OV cut carries the gate (approx the analytic gating value). Falsifies H2.3/H3.2 for the trained model.
verdict.check_i_content_gated: CONFIRMED - content-dependent attention is load-bearing (full beats pos-only/affine).
verdict.check_ii_QK_cut: FALSIFIED as QK; TRUE for OV. Raw FRA-QK cut = +0.0007 (gauge-robust null); FRA-OV cut = +0.0203 (approx gating value), gauge-robust.
verdict.check_iii_null: CONFIRMED - both cuts approx 0 on null; gating value 0; total parent->child dependence approx 0.
verdict.check_iv_selectivity: PARTIAL - OV cut degrades child; parent is current-token-sufficient (QK barely moves it) but OV cut dparent=0.026 not clean (shared parent-value path).
verdict.mechanism: 2-hop (depth>=2, Prop H4.0): layer-1 reads parent via OV -> builds a derived recency feature; layer-2 child-query gates on the DERIVED feature, not raw d_P -> raw (child-query, parent-key) QK cell empty. Parent's ENTRY is OV.
verdict.fra_win_law_sharpened: Two-position product is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT for a QK handle. A content GATE (hierarchy) is OV-realizable and lands in OV. FRA-QK is the carrier only for an obligate query-key MATCH (induction/fra_win). Gate carrier set >= 3: LayerNorm, OV, derived-feature-QK.
verdict.caveat: Single seed per cell; the 28x QK<<OV asymmetry is clean and gauge-flat and mechanistically expected, but seed-robustness is a quick follow-up if wanted.
